top_signals.title: Iron Ore Climbs as Traders Weigh Supply Risks From BHP Strike
top_signals.summary: Iron ore rose as threat of strike action by BHP Group workers at the export hub of Port Hedland raised concerns about potential supply disruptions, although weak Chinese demand will likely cap price gains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Coldcard issues Mk3 warning as experts examine $38M Bitcoin wallet drain
top_signals.summary: Coinkite urged Coldcard Mk3 users to migrate funds after identifying a potential seed-generation risk, as Bitcoin security experts separately examine an unexplained $38 million wallet drain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Korea Cites Close Ties With US, Japan After Overnight FX Surge
top_signals.summary: South Korea’s foreign-exchange authorities are in close contact with counterparts in the US and Japan, a senior finance ministry official said, a day after Tokyo mounted a large-scale operation to prop up the yen.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: LG to Ban Residential Proxies from Smart TV Apps
top_signals.summary: The home appliance giant LG Electronics USA said this week it plans to suspend any apps built for its smart TVs that turn one's television into an always-on residential proxy node. The move comes less than a month after researchers found that more than 42 percent of games and other apps available for download on LG's webOS store allow unknown third-parties to route their Internet traffic through a user's TV.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
